q: 他昨天迟到了，今天___迟到了。
zh: 他昨天迟到了，今天又迟到了。
py: tā zuó tiān chí dào le jīn tiān yòu chí dào le
en: He was late yesterday and was late again today.
why: Both lateness events are already facts (昨天, 今天 plus 了), so the repeat is 又. 再 only looks forward to a repeat that has not happened yet.

q: 你怎么___忘了带电脑？
zh: 你怎么又忘了带电脑？
py: nǐ zěn me yòu wàng le dài diàn nǎo
en: How come you forgot your laptop again?
why: 怎么 plus 了 complains about something that has already happened a second time, which is 又. 再 cannot report a past event, and 才 means 'only then'.

q: 我上个星期感冒了，这个星期___感冒了。
zh: 我上个星期感冒了，这个星期又感冒了。
py: wǒ shàng ge xīng qī gǎn mào le zhè ge xīng qī yòu gǎn mào le
en: I caught a cold last week and caught one again this week.
why: The second cold is a past fact marked by 了, so 又 is required. 再 belongs to repeats that have not occurred yet.

q: 他上午没来开会，下午___没来。
zh: 他上午没来开会，下午又没来。
py: tā shàng wǔ méi lái kāi huì xià wǔ yòu méi lái
en: He didn't come to the meeting in the morning, and he didn't come again in the afternoon.
why: A repeated 'didn't' that has already happened is 又没. 再没来 would not describe a second absence that is already a fact.

q: 明天___是星期一了，我真不想上班。
zh: 明天又是星期一了，我真不想上班。
py: míng tiān yòu shì xīng qī yī le wǒ zhēn bù xiǎng shàng bān
en: Tomorrow is Monday again, and I really don't want to go to work.
why: Monday is bound to come round on the calendar, so 又是…了 is used even though it is about tomorrow. 再 would be a request or plan, and 还 would mean 'still'.

q: 这个月___要交报告了，我得赶紧写。
zh: 这个月又要交报告了，我得赶紧写。
py: zhè ge yuè yòu yào jiāo bào gào le wǒ děi gǎn jǐn xiě
en: The report is due again this month, so I have to hurry and write it.
why: A deadline that comes round on schedule uses 又要…了 with 了 at the end. 再要 would be a request, not a fixed recurrence.

q: 医生让我少吃盐，可是我今天___吃了一大碗咸菜。
zh: 医生让我少吃盐，可是我今天又吃了一大碗咸菜。
py: yī shēng ràng wǒ shǎo chī yán kě shì wǒ jīn tiān yòu chī le yī dà wǎn xián cài
en: The doctor told me to eat less salt, but today I ate a big bowl of pickles again.
why: The pickles were eaten already (了), and 可是 shows the habit is repeating, so 又. 再 would need the eating to lie in the future.

q: 他的腰___疼了，今天只好请假。
zh: 他的腰又疼了，今天只好请假。
py: tā de yāo yòu téng le jīn tiān zhǐ hǎo qǐng jià
en: His back hurts again, so today he has to take leave.
why: The pain has come back and is a present fact, marked by 了, so 又. 再 is for future repeats and 还 would say it still hurts, with no 了.

q: 打印机昨天刚修好，今天___坏了，大家都很无奈。
zh: 打印机昨天刚修好，今天又坏了，大家都很无奈。
py: dǎ yìn jī zuó tiān gāng xiū hǎo jīn tiān yòu huài le dà jiā dōu hěn wú nài
en: The printer was only just fixed yesterday and broke again today, and everyone feels helpless.
why: The breakdown has already happened (坏了), so it is 又. 再坏了 is impossible because 再 cannot report a completed repeat.

q: 他吃了药，可是晚上___发烧了。
zh: 他吃了药，可是晚上又发烧了。
py: tā chī le yào kě shì wǎn shang yòu fā shāo le
en: He took the medicine, but his fever came back in the evening.
why: 晚上 plus 了 reports the fever as a fact that has returned, so 又. 再 would suggest the fever had not come yet.

q: 对不起，请您___说一遍。
zh: 对不起，请您再说一遍。
py: duì bu qǐ qǐng nín zài shuō yī biàn
en: Sorry, please say it once more.
why: A polite request is about something that has not happened yet, so 再. 又 reports a repeat already done, and 还 does not mean 'again' in a request.

q: 这个字我不会写，你___写一次，好吗？
zh: 这个字我不会写，你再写一次，好吗？
py: zhè ge zì wǒ bù huì xiě nǐ zài xiě yī cì hǎo ma
en: I can't write this character. Could you write it once more?
why: The speaker asks for a new repetition, which is still to come: 再 plus an amount (一次). 又 would claim the writing has already been repeated.

q: 报告有一个错字，你___检查一遍吧。
zh: 报告有一个错字，你再检查一遍吧。
py: bào gào yǒu yī gè cuò zì nǐ zài jiǎn chá yī biàn ba
en: There is a typo in the report. Check it over once more.
why: The suggestion with 吧 is about a check that has not been done again yet, so 再. 又 would need a finished repeat marked by 了.

q: 这个问题我们下次开会___讨论吧。
zh: 这个问题我们下次开会再讨论吧。
py: zhè ge wèn tí wǒ men xià cì kāi huì zài tǎo lùn ba
en: Let's discuss this problem again at the next meeting.
why: 下次 and 吧 point to a future plan, so 再. 又 reports something done, and 还 would mean 'still' or 'also', not 'again later'.

q: 你的咳嗽还没好，要不要___休息两天？
zh: 你的咳嗽还没好，要不要再休息两天？
py: nǐ de ké sou hái méi hǎo yào bu yào zài xiū xi liǎng tiān
en: Your cough isn't better yet. Why not rest two more days?
why: A suggestion about more rest in the future takes 再 plus an amount of time. 又 would claim the extra rest has already happened.

q: 这份文件有几个地方不清楚，请你___发一次。
zh: 这份文件有几个地方不清楚，请你再发一次。
py: zhè fèn wén jiàn yǒu jǐ gè dì fang bù qīng chu qǐng nǐ zài fā yī cì
en: A few places in this file aren't clear. Please send it once more.
why: 请 makes it a request for a repeat that has not happened, so 再. 又 would be wrong without 了 and a finished event.

q: 时间还早，你___睡十分钟吧。
zh: 时间还早，你再睡十分钟吧。
py: shí jiān hái zǎo nǐ zài shuì shí fēn zhōng ba
en: It's still early. Sleep ten more minutes.
why: A suggestion to add a little more sleep is a not-yet-happened repeat, so 再. 又 cannot go with 吧, and 才 means 'not until'.

q: 这个菜不够，我们___点一个吧。
zh: 这个菜不够，我们再点一个吧。
py: zhè ge cài bù gòu wǒ men zài diǎn yī gè ba
en: This dish isn't enough. Let's order one more.
why: Ordering one more is a plan for the moment ahead, so 再 with 吧. 又 would say the extra order is already in.

q: 护士说，明天上午你___来检查一次就可以了。
zh: 护士说，明天上午你再来检查一次就可以了。
py: hù shi shuō míng tiān shàng wǔ nǐ zài lái jiǎn chá yī cì jiù kě yǐ le
en: The nurse said you only need to come back for one more check tomorrow morning.
why: 明天上午 is in the future and the check is a repeat that is still to happen, so 再. 又 needs the repeat to be a fact or a certain recurrence.

q: 这个数据好像不对，麻烦你___核对一下，然后发给我。
zh: 这个数据好像不对，麻烦你再核对一下，然后发给我。
py: zhè ge shù jù hǎo xiàng bù duì má fan nǐ zài hé duì yī xià rán hòu fā gěi wǒ
en: This data doesn't look right. Please check it once more and then send it to me.
why: 麻烦你 asks for another check that has not been done, so 再. 又 would report a check already carried out twice.

q: 已经十点了，他___在睡觉。
zh: 已经十点了，他还在睡觉。
py: yǐ jīng shí diǎn le tā hái zài shuì jiào
en: It's already ten o'clock and he is still sleeping.
why: The sleeping goes on unchanged, which is 还在 + verb. 又 and 再 mean 'again', but he never stopped sleeping.

q: 会议已经开始了，经理还没到___。
zh: 会议已经开始了，经理还没到呢。
py: huì yì yǐ jīng kāi shǐ le jīng lǐ hái méi dào ne
en: The meeting has already started and the manager still hasn't arrived.
why: 还没 describes an unchanged state and takes the particle 呢. 了 marks a change and clashes with 还没, and 吗 would turn it into a question.

q: 医生，我吃了三天药，咳嗽___没好。
zh: 医生，我吃了三天药，咳嗽还没好。
py: yī shēng wǒ chī le sān tiān yào ké sou hái méi hǎo
en: Doctor, I've taken the medicine for three days and my cough still isn't better.
why: The cough has stayed as it was, so 还没. 又没好 would need an earlier non-recovery to repeat, and 再 is only for future repeats.

q: 过了一个星期，他的腿___很疼。
zh: 过了一个星期，他的腿还是很疼。
py: guò le yī gè xīng qī tā de tuǐ hái shi hěn téng
en: A week has passed and his leg still hurts a lot.
why: 还是 before an adjective means 'still the same despite the time that passed'. 又是 and 再是 do not work before an adjective of state.

q: 我已经解释了两遍，可是同事___不明白。
zh: 我已经解释了两遍，可是同事还是不明白。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng jiě shì le liǎng biàn kě shì tóng shì hái shi bù míng bai
en: I have explained it twice, but my colleague still doesn't understand.
why: 可是 introduces the unchanged result after two explanations, which is 还是 + 不. 又是 and 再是 are not used this way.

q: 从早上到现在，外面___在下雨。
zh: 从早上到现在，外面还在下雨。
py: cóng zǎo shang dào xiàn zài wài miàn hái zài xià yǔ
en: It has been raining outside from this morning until now, and it still is.
why: 从早上到现在 shows one continuous event, so 还在. 又在下雨 would mean the rain had stopped and started again.

q: 他都工作十二个小时了，现在___在改那份报告。
zh: 他都工作十二个小时了，现在还在改那份报告。
py: tā dōu gōng zuò shí èr gè xiǎo shí le xiàn zài hái zài gǎi nà fèn bào gào
en: He has worked for twelve hours and is still revising that report now.
why: The work has gone on without a break, so 还在. 又 would require a pause between two stretches of work and 再 is not used for a state in progress.

q: 到现在，她的午饭___没吃呢。
zh: 到现在，她的午饭还没吃呢。
py: dào xiàn zài tā de wǔ fàn hái méi chī ne
en: Up to now she hasn't eaten her lunch yet.
why: 到现在 and 呢 show a state that has not changed: 还没…呢. 又 would imply she skipped lunch before, and 再没 does not fit a plain current fact.

q: 我们公司搬了新办公室，可是老板___坐在原来的位子上。
zh: 我们公司搬了新办公室，可是老板还是坐在原来的位子上。
py: wǒ men gōng sī bān le xīn bàn gōng shì kě shì lǎo bǎn hái shi zuò zài yuán lái de wèi zi shang
en: Our company moved into a new office, but the boss still sits in his old seat.
why: The move is a change, and 可是 introduces what stayed the same, so 还是. 又是 and 再是 cannot express 'as before'.

q: 医生，我头疼，___有点儿发烧。
zh: 医生，我头疼，还有点儿发烧。
py: yī shēng wǒ tóu téng hái yǒu diǎn r fā shāo
en: Doctor, I have a headache and also a bit of a fever.
why: 还 adds a second symptom to the first one, so it means 'also'. 再 would mean 'again', and 才 means 'only then'.

q: 你除了咳嗽，___有哪里不舒服吗？
zh: 你除了咳嗽，还有哪里不舒服吗？
py: nǐ chú le ké sou hái yǒu nǎ lǐ bù shū fu ma
en: Besides the cough, is there anywhere else you feel unwell?
why: 除了…还 adds items to a list, so 还. 再 would repeat something and 才 would stress lateness.

q: 小王会说英语，___会说日语。
zh: 小王会说英语，还会说日语。
py: xiǎo wáng huì shuō yīng yǔ hái huì shuō rì yǔ
en: Xiao Wang can speak English, and Japanese as well.
why: Adding a second skill is 还 before the verb. 再 means doing the same thing again, which is not the point here.

q: 你明天___来上班吗？我想把文件给你。
zh: 你明天还来上班吗？我想把文件给你。
py: nǐ míng tiān hái lái shàng bān ma wǒ xiǎng bǎ wén jiàn gěi nǐ
en: Will you come to work again tomorrow? I'd like to give you the files.
why: A yes/no question about a future repeat uses 还 for 'again'. 又 is for repeats that have already happened or are certain.

q: 这些药你每天早上吃，晚上___要吃一片这个。
zh: 这些药你每天早上吃，晚上还要吃一片这个。
py: zhè xiē yào nǐ měi tiān zǎo shang chī wǎn shang hái yào chī yī piàn zhè ge
en: Take this medicine every morning, and in the evening you also need one tablet of this one.
why: 还要 adds something to what is already there, so 还 before 要. 又要 would mean 'need to again', which does not match the added second medicine.

q: 你除了这份报告，___需要什么资料？
zh: 你除了这份报告，还需要什么资料？
py: nǐ chú le zhè fèn bào gào hái xū yào shén me zī liào
en: Besides this report, what other materials do you need?
why: 除了…还 asks what else is needed, so 还. 才 would mean 'only then' and does not ask for additional items.

q: 桌子上有文件，___有一杯茶。
zh: 桌子上有文件，还有一杯茶。
py: zhuō zi shang yǒu wén jiàn hái yǒu yī bēi chá
en: On the desk there are files, and also a cup of tea.
why: 还有 adds one more thing that exists, so 还. 再有 does not describe an item that is already on the desk.

q: 我___想再看一遍那份合同。
zh: 我还想再看一遍那份合同。
py: wǒ hái xiǎng zài kàn yī biàn nà fèn hé tong
en: I'd like to go over that contract once more.
why: 还 goes before the modal 想, while 再 stays right before 看. 再想再 would repeat 再 in the wrong place.

q: 我想___去医院检查一次。
zh: 我想再去医院检查一次。
py: wǒ xiǎng zài qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá yī cì
en: I want to go to the hospital for another check-up.
why: After the modal 想, 再 sits directly before the repeated action 去. 还 and 又 would go before 想, not after it.

q: 下午我得___开一个会。
zh: 下午我得再开一个会。
py: xià wǔ wǒ děi zài kāi yī gè huì
en: This afternoon I have to hold one more meeting.
why: 再 attaches to the verb 开 and so comes after the modal 得. 还 or 又 would have to precede 得.

q: 你___可以再休息一天。
zh: 你还可以再休息一天。
py: nǐ hái kě yǐ zài xiū xi yī tiān
en: You can still rest one more day.
why: 还 stands before the modal 可以 and means 'still', while 再 sits before 休息. 再可以 puts 再 in front of the modal, which is wrong.

q: 他___想喝咖啡了，我看他是太困了。
zh: 他又想喝咖啡了，我看他是太困了。
py: tā yòu xiǎng hē kā fēi le wǒ kàn tā shì tài kùn le
en: He wants coffee again. I think he is just too sleepy.
why: The wish has come back and 了 closes the sentence, so 又 goes before 想. 再想 puts 再 before the modal, and 还想…了 would not mean 'again'.

q: 我们能不能___讨论一下这个计划？
zh: 我们能不能再讨论一下这个计划？
py: wǒ men néng bu néng zài tǎo lùn yī xià zhè ge jì huà
en: Could we discuss this plan once more?
why: 再 comes after 能不能 and before the repeated verb 讨论. 还 and 又 do not fit after the modal here.

q: 你的伤还没好，不能___运动。
zh: 你的伤还没好，不能再运动。
py: nǐ de shāng hái méi hǎo bù néng zài yùn dòng
en: Your injury hasn't healed yet, so you can't exercise any more.
why: 再 goes after the modal 不能 and before 运动. 不能还运动 and 不能又运动 are both ungrammatical.

q: 这个病很难受，我不想___得了。
zh: 这个病很难受，我不想再得了。
py: zhè ge bìng hěn nán shòu wǒ bù xiǎng zài dé le
en: This illness is miserable. I don't want to get it again.
why: The repeat is in the future, and 再 follows the modal 想 right before 得. 又 would claim it has already happened again.

q: 我们___吃饭，___去开会吧。
zh: 我们先吃饭，再去开会吧。
py: wǒ men xiān chī fàn zài qù kāi huì ba
en: Let's eat first and then go to the meeting.
why: 先 marks the first step and 再 the second, both after the subject. 又 would describe a step already done, which does not fit a suggestion with 吧.

q: 你先量体温，___去找医生吧。
zh: 你先量体温，再去找医生吧。
py: nǐ xiān liáng tǐ wēn zài qù zhǎo yī shēng ba
en: Take your temperature first, then go and see the doctor.
why: 先…再 sequences two future steps. 又 would report a step already finished and 还 does not mean 'then'.

q: 等经理回来___开会吧。
zh: 等经理回来再开会吧。
py: děng jīng lǐ huí lái zài kāi huì ba
en: Let's hold the meeting after the manager comes back.
why: 再 postpones the meeting until the condition in 等…is met. 又 and 还 cannot mean 'then'.

q: 今天太累了，这件事明天___说吧。
zh: 今天太累了，这件事明天再说吧。
py: jīn tiān tài lèi le zhè jiàn shì míng tiān zài shuō ba
en: I'm too tired today. Let's talk about this tomorrow.
why: 再 puts the talk off until tomorrow. 又 would claim it was already discussed, and 还 does not postpone anything.

q: 你吃完药___睡觉，这样胃不会难受。
zh: 你吃完药再睡觉，这样胃不会难受。
py: nǐ chī wán yào zài shuì jiào zhè yàng wèi bù huì nán shòu
en: Go to sleep after you've taken the medicine, so your stomach won't feel bad.
why: 吃完药再…means 'only after the medicine'. 又 and 还 do not mark the second step of a sequence.

q: 先把这几份文件整理好，___交给财务部，千万别弄错。
zh: 先把这几份文件整理好，再交给财务部，千万别弄错。
py: xiān bǎ zhè jǐ fèn wén jiàn zhěng lǐ hǎo zài jiāo gěi cái wù bù qiān wàn bié nòng cuò
en: First sort these documents, then hand them to the finance department, and be careful not to get it wrong.
why: 先…再 orders two jobs, and the handing over comes after the sorting. 又 would report a finished step and 还 would add an unrelated action.

q: 大夫说，你的烧退了以后___吃这种药。
zh: 大夫说，你的烧退了以后再吃这种药。
py: dài fu shuō nǐ de shāo tuì le yǐ hòu zài chī zhè zhǒng yào
en: The doctor said to take this kind of medicine only after your fever goes down.
why: 以后再 delays the action until the fever is gone. 又 would mean the taking has already happened again.

q: 我先看一下邮件，___回复你。
zh: 我先看一下邮件，再回复你。
py: wǒ xiān kàn yī xià yóu jiàn zài huí fù nǐ
en: I'll check my email first and then reply to you.
why: 先…再 gives the planned order: reading before replying. 又 and 还 cannot mean 'then' in a plan.

q: 上次在那家诊所等了三个小时，我___也不想去了。
zh: 上次在那家诊所等了三个小时，我再也不想去了。
py: shàng cì zài nà jiā zhěn suǒ děng le sān gè xiǎo shí wǒ zài yě bù xiǎng qù le
en: Last time I waited three hours at that clinic, and I never want to go again.
why: 'Never again' is the fixed frame 再也不. 又也 and 还也 do not exist, so 再 is the only choice.

q: 他辞职以后，___也没来过公司。
zh: 他辞职以后，再也没来过公司。
py: tā cí zhí yǐ hòu zài yě méi lái guo gōng sī
en: After he resigned, he never came to the company again.
why: 再也没…过 says it has not happened again since a past point. 又也没 and 还也没 are not used.

q: 我___不喝酒了，对身体太不好。
zh: 我再也不喝酒了，对身体太不好。
py: wǒ zài yě bù hē jiǔ le duì shēn tǐ tài bù hǎo
en: I'll never drink again. It's too bad for my body.
why: The fixed order is 再 then 也 then 不. 也再 reverses it and 又也 swaps in the wrong adverb.

q: 自从那次以后，他再也___去过那家医院。
zh: 自从那次以后，他再也没去过那家医院。
py: zì cóng nà cì yǐ hòu tā zài yě méi qù guo nà jiā yī yuàn
en: Since that time he has never gone to that hospital again.
why: The time frame is past, since then, and 过 closes it, so 再也没…过. 再也不 looks ahead from now and does not combine with 过.

q: 这个项目让大家累坏了，我再也___想接这样的工作了。
zh: 这个项目让大家累坏了，我再也不想接这样的工作了。
py: zhè ge xiàng mù ràng dà jiā lèi huài le wǒ zài yě bù xiǎng jiē zhè yàng de gōng zuò le
en: This project wore everyone out, and I never want to take on this kind of work again.
why: A decision from now on takes 再也不. 没 would negate a past fact, but 想 here states a present attitude.

q: 这家诊所___近___方便，我常去。
zh: 这家诊所又近又方便，我常去。
py: zhè jiā zhěn suǒ yòu jìn yòu fāng biàn wǒ cháng qù
en: This clinic is both close and convenient, so I go there often.
why: Two good qualities at once use 又…又…. 还…还 and 再…再 are not the frame for 'both A and B'.

q: 她今天___发烧___咳嗽，只好在家休息。
zh: 她今天又发烧又咳嗽，只好在家休息。
py: tā jīn tiān yòu fā shāo yòu ké sou zhǐ hǎo zài jiā xiū xi
en: Today she has both a fever and a cough, so she has to rest at home.
why: Two simultaneous problems fit 又…又…. Replacing the second 又 with 再 or putting 还 first breaks the paired frame.

q: 这份工作___忙___累，可是工资不高，我想换一个。
zh: 这份工作又忙又累，可是工资不高，我想换一个。
py: zhè fèn gōng zuò yòu máng yòu lèi kě shì gōng zī bù gāo wǒ xiǎng huàn yī gè
en: This job is both busy and tiring, but the pay isn't high, so I want to change.
why: Both adjectives are bare inside 又…又…, with no 很. Using 很 for either half breaks the pattern.

q: 孩子发烧了，___哭___闹，妈妈很着急。
zh: 孩子发烧了，又哭又闹，妈妈很着急。
py: hái zi fā shāo le yòu kū yòu nào mā ma hěn zháo jí
en: The child has a fever and is both crying and making a fuss, so the mother is very worried.
why: Two actions happening together take 又…又…. 再…再 and 还…还 do not express 'both at once'.

q: 这个屏幕太小了，有没有___大一点儿的？
zh: 这个屏幕太小了，有没有再大一点儿的？
py: zhè ge píng mù tài xiǎo le yǒu méi yǒu zài dà yī diǎn r de
en: This screen is too small. Do you have a slightly bigger one?
why: Asking for a bit more of a quality is 再 + adjective + 一点儿. 又 and 太 cannot stand there.

q: 会议室有点儿吵，请把声音调得___小一点儿。
zh: 会议室有点儿吵，请把声音调得再小一点儿。
py: huì yì shì yǒu diǎn r chǎo qǐng bǎ shēng yīn tiáo de zài xiǎo yī diǎn r
en: The meeting room is a bit noisy. Please turn the sound down a little more.
why: The request wants a little more of 小, so 再 before the adjective. 又小 cannot be asked for, and 太小一点儿 is a contradiction.

q: 你说得太快了，能不能___慢一点儿？
zh: 你说得太快了，能不能再慢一点儿？
py: nǐ shuō de tài kuài le néng bu néng zài màn yī diǎn r
en: You speak too fast. Could you speak a little slower?
why: A request for slightly more slowness is 再慢一点儿. 又 and 太 cannot take that role.

q: 这个床垫太硬了，我想要一个___软一点儿的。
zh: 这个床垫太硬了，我想要一个再软一点儿的。
py: zhè ge chuáng diàn tài yìng le wǒ xiǎng yào yī gè zài ruǎn yī diǎn r de
en: This mattress is too hard. I'd like one that is a little softer.
why: 再 + adjective + 一点儿 asks for a bit more softness. 又软 and 太软 would not make that request.

zh: 请你再检查一遍。
py: qǐng nǐ zài jiǎn chá yī biàn
en: Please check it once more.
why: A request is about a repeat that has not happened, so 再 goes before the verb and the amount 一遍 follows it. 又 is not possible.

zh: 我们先开会再吃饭。
py: wǒ men xiān kāi huì zài chī fàn
en: We'll hold the meeting first and then eat.
why: 先 and 再 both come after the subject and before their verbs, giving the first step then the second.

zh: 我想再休息一天。
py: wǒ xiǎng zài xiū xi yī tiān
en: I'd like to rest one more day.
why: 再 belongs to the repeated action 休息, so it stands after the modal 想 and before the verb.

zh: 我还想再睡一会儿。
py: wǒ hái xiǎng zài shuì yī huì r
en: I'd like to sleep a bit longer still.
why: 还 comes before the modal 想, and 再 comes after it, directly before 睡. The order 还, 想, 再 is fixed.

zh: 医生今天又忙又累。
py: yī shēng jīn tiān yòu máng yòu lèi
en: The doctor is both busy and tired today.
why: 又 + adjective twice states two qualities at once, with no 很. 今天 can come before or after the subject.

zh: 他今天又没来。
py: tā jīn tiān yòu méi lái
en: He didn't come again today.
why: 又 comes right before 没 to repeat a past absence. The time word may go before or after 他, but 又 must stay next to 没.

zh: 经理还在开会。
py: jīng lǐ hái zài kāi huì
en: The manager is still in a meeting.
why: 还 goes before 在 to say the meeting has not ended. 再 would not mean 'still'.

zh: 我再也不加班了。
py: wǒ zài yě bù jiā bān le
en: I'm never working overtime again.
why: The fixed frame is 再 then 也 then 不, followed by the verb and 了 for the new decision.

zh: 你说得再慢一点儿。
py: nǐ shuō de zài màn yī diǎn r
en: Speak a bit more slowly.
why: 再 stands directly before the adjective 慢, and 一点儿 comes after it. 又 cannot be used here.

zh: 你还需要什么资料？
py: nǐ hái xū yào shén me zī liào
en: What other materials do you need?
why: 还 asks what else is needed, so it comes before the verb 需要. 又 would sound like a complaint.

src_py: tā jīn tiān chí dào le
task: Say he was late again today.
zh: 他今天又迟到了。
py: tā jīn tiān yòu chí dào le
en: He was late again today.
why: A repeat that has already happened takes 又 before the verb, with 了 at the end. 再 cannot report a past event.

src_py: hù shi zài gěi bìng rén liáng tǐ wēn
task: Say it is still going on.
zh: 护士还在给病人量体温。
py: hù shi hái zài gěi bìng rén liáng tǐ wēn
en: The nurse is still taking the patient's temperature.
why: 还 goes before 在 to show the action has not stopped. 再 and 又 would mean 'again'.

src_py: wǒ bù hē kā fēi le
task: Say you will never drink coffee again.
zh: 我再也不喝咖啡了。
py: wǒ zài yě bù hē kā fēi le
en: I'll never drink coffee again.
why: 'Never again' uses the fixed frame 再也不 before the verb. 又 and 还 cannot replace 再 in it.

src_py: nǐ chī wán fàn rán hòu chī yào
task: Use 先…再 to put eating first.
zh: 你先吃饭再吃药。
py: nǐ xiān chī fàn zài chī yào
en: Eat first, then take the medicine.
why: 先 and 再 follow the subject, one before each verb. 又 would not give a plan for a step still to come.

src_py: zhè ge zhěn tou yǒu diǎn r yìng
task: Ask for a slightly softer one.
zh: 有没有再软一点儿的？
py: yǒu méi yǒu zài ruǎn yī diǎn r de
en: Do you have a slightly softer one?
why: Asking for a bit more of a quality is 再 + adjective + 一点儿. 又 cannot stand before a single adjective.

s: 明天又是星期一了，真不想上班。
s_py: míng tiān yòu shì xīng qī yī le zhēn bù xiǎng shàng bān
zh: 明天又是星期一了，真不想上班。
py: míng tiān yòu shì xīng qī yī le zhēn bù xiǎng shàng bān
en: Tomorrow is Monday again. I really don't want to go to work.
why: Though it is about tomorrow, Monday is certain to come round, so 又是…了 is correct. 再 would be for a plan or request.

s: 他昨天再迟到了。
s_py: tā zuó tiān zài chí dào le
zh: 他昨天又迟到了。
py: tā zuó tiān yòu chí dào le
en: He was late again yesterday.
why: 昨天 and 了 show the repeat already happened, so 又 is needed. 再 only points forward.

s: 请您又写一次名字。
s_py: qǐng nín yòu xiě yī cì míng zi
zh: 请您再写一次名字。
py: qǐng nín zài xiě yī cì míng zi
en: Please write your name once more.
why: 请 makes it a request for a repeat that has not happened, so 再. 又 reports a finished repeat.

s: 今天先到这儿，我们明天再讨论。
s_py: jīn tiān xiān dào zhè r wǒ men míng tiān zài tǎo lùn
zh: 今天先到这儿，我们明天再讨论。
py: jīn tiān xiān dào zhè r wǒ men míng tiān zài tǎo lùn
en: Let's stop here for today and discuss it tomorrow.
why: 再 postpones the discussion to tomorrow, a plan not yet carried out. 又 would be wrong even though 明天 looks like a repeat.

s: 护士还没下班了。
s_py: hù shi hái méi xià bān le
zh: 护士还没下班呢。
py: hù shi hái méi xià bān ne
en: The nurse hasn't gone off duty yet.
why: 还没 states an unchanged situation, so it takes 呢, not 了, which marks a change.

s: 我吃了药，可是头还是很疼。
s_py: wǒ chī le yào kě shì tóu hái shi hěn téng
zh: 我吃了药，可是头还是很疼。
py: wǒ chī le yào kě shì tóu hái shi hěn téng
en: I took medicine, but my head still hurts a lot.
why: 还是 before an adjective means 'still the same', and 吃了药 is the change that did not help. 又 would mean the pain came back.

s: 已经十二点了，他再在开会。
s_py: yǐ jīng shí èr diǎn le tā zài zài kāi huì
zh: 已经十二点了，他还在开会。
py: yǐ jīng shí èr diǎn le tā hái zài kāi huì
en: It's already twelve o'clock and he is still in a meeting.
why: 'Still going on' is 还在. 再 cannot mean still and cannot stand before 在.

s: 你明天还来公司吗？
s_py: nǐ míng tiān hái lái gōng sī ma
zh: 你明天还来公司吗？
py: nǐ míng tiān hái lái gōng sī ma
en: Are you coming to the office again tomorrow?
why: In a yes/no question about a future repeat, 还 is the normal word for 'again'. Learners expect 再, but 还 is correct here.

s: 你再有什么问题吗？
s_py: nǐ zài yǒu shén me wèn tí ma
zh: 你还有什么问题吗？
py: nǐ hái yǒu shén me wèn tí ma
en: Do you have any other questions?
why: 'Anything else' adds to what is already asked, so 还有. 再有 is not used in a plain question like this.

s: 我想再检查一遍这份报告。
s_py: wǒ xiǎng zài jiǎn chá yī biàn zhè fèn bào gào
zh: 我想再检查一遍这份报告。
py: wǒ xiǎng zài jiǎn chá yī biàn zhè fèn bào gào
en: I want to check this report once more.
why: 再 follows the modal 想 and stands right before the repeated verb. This is the correct order.

s: 他再想休息一天。
s_py: tā zài xiǎng xiū xi yī tiān
zh: 他想再休息一天。
py: tā xiǎng zài xiū xi yī tiān
en: He wants to rest one more day.
why: 再 must come after 想, right before the repeated action. 再想 puts it before the modal.

s: 我还想再问你一个问题。
s_py: wǒ hái xiǎng zài wèn nǐ yī gè wèn tí
zh: 我还想再问你一个问题。
py: wǒ hái xiǎng zài wèn nǐ yī gè wèn tí
en: I'd like to ask you one more question.
why: 还 before the modal and 再 after it can appear together: 还想再. The sentence is correct.

s: 我们先开会，又吃午饭吧。
s_py: wǒ men xiān kāi huì yòu chī wǔ fàn ba
zh: 我们先开会，再吃午饭吧。
py: wǒ men xiān kāi huì zài chī wǔ fàn ba
en: Let's have the meeting first and then eat lunch.
why: The second step of a plan not yet carried out pairs with 先 as 再. 又 reports finished actions.

s: 你先做检查，再决定要不要吃药。
s_py: nǐ xiān zuò jiǎn chá zài jué dìng yào bu yào chī yào
zh: 你先做检查，再决定要不要吃药。
py: nǐ xiān zuò jiǎn chá zài jué dìng yào bu yào chī yào
en: First have the examination, then decide whether to take medicine.
why: 先…再 orders the two steps, and 再 can introduce a long clause with an A-not-A question. The sentence is correct.

s: 我又也不熬夜了，对身体不好。
s_py: wǒ yòu yě bù áo yè le duì shēn tǐ bù hǎo
zh: 我再也不熬夜了，对身体不好。
py: wǒ zài yě bù áo yè le duì shēn tǐ bù hǎo
en: I'll never stay up late again; it's bad for my health.
why: 'Never again' is the fixed frame 再也不. 又也不 does not exist.

s: 他换了工作，再也没联系过我。
s_py: tā huàn le gōng zuò zài yě méi lián xì guo wǒ
zh: 他换了工作，再也没联系过我。
py: tā huàn le gōng zuò zài yě méi lián xì guo wǒ
en: He changed jobs and has never contacted me again.
why: Since a past point nothing has happened again, so 再也没…过 is right. Using 不 here would not fit the past time frame.

s: 这间办公室又很大又很亮。
s_py: zhè jiān bàn gōng shì yòu hěn dà yòu hěn liàng
zh: 这间办公室又大又亮。
py: zhè jiān bàn gōng shì yòu dà yòu liàng
en: This office is both big and bright.
why: Inside 又…又 the adjectives stay bare. 很 cannot be added.

s: 我今天又累又困，想早点儿睡。
s_py: wǒ jīn tiān yòu lèi yòu kùn xiǎng zǎo diǎn r shuì
zh: 我今天又累又困，想早点儿睡。
py: wǒ jīn tiān yòu lèi yòu kùn xiǎng zǎo diǎn r shuì
en: I'm both tired and sleepy today and want to sleep early.
why: 又累又困 correctly joins two bad conditions at once with no 很. The sentence is correct.

s: 这个价格太高了，能不能又便宜一点儿？
s_py: zhè ge jià gé tài gāo le néng bu néng yòu pián yi yī diǎn r
zh: 这个价格太高了，能不能再便宜一点儿？
py: zhè ge jià gé tài gāo le néng bu néng zài pián yi yī diǎn r
en: This price is too high. Can it be a little cheaper?
why: Asking for a little more of a quality is 再 + adjective + 一点儿. 又 cannot be used in a request like this.

s: 你怎么又没带工作证？
s_py: nǐ zěn me yòu méi dài gōng zuò zhèng
zh: 你怎么又没带工作证？
py: nǐ zěn me yòu méi dài gōng zuò zhèng
en: How come you didn't bring your work pass again?
why: A repeated 'didn't' that has already happened is 又没, and 怎么 expresses the annoyance. The sentence is correct.
